title: Research: native binding for the P104 two-target correction
body:
PR2445's logical Y0/Y1 correction left its 236 added frame transports without native coverage. This package supplies **161 exact native transport pairs and their adjoints**, then checks the complete forward composition over **358 arbitrary inputs / 128,164 boundary coefficients**. All 161 pairs are absent from the retained 740-pair channel certificate; this is a comparison with that specific predecessor, not a general novelty claim.

Only `research/p104-two-target-native/` is added (12 files). Exact head `3170afd2fc13a990bfe28f5ab6421bcda4ffd0f6`, scientific base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. PR2445's word and 78-helper minimum are credited unchanged at `6def43ad673b91dbd491389964d1dcd059bf2ac2`.

Each of the 322 forward/adjoint recipes is checked by the retained independent signed-Pauli/exact-Gaussian interpreter, including global phase and positive-child rank. A separate specialist wrote the new occurrence/chart/full-column checker without importing the producer. It checks exact chart representatives, all 236 added occurrences, the inherited 740 edges and 208 endpoint adapters, all 358 final charts, Y0/Y1 identity transfers, the other 102 G/2 rows, and logical restoration of all 104 sources and 150 dirty helpers. The original eight owned-copy discard lifetimes remain explicit. The added profile stays 142H1+16H2+18H6+60H7, rank mass 702, with 440 scalar ADDs.

Validation: registered **CPython 3.12.12 optimized replay PASS**, complete decompressed certificate regeneration, ten rejecting and two equivalent-presentation controls, six behavioral groups, Git-free/read-only replay and phase-predicate deletion sensitivity. Separate specialist **CPython 3.14.6 normal replay PASS**. Metadata/source pins, selected-record integrity and whitespace pass. Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-two-target-native`. Hosted CI is separate and has not been claimed passed.

The written frame-invariant proof establishes only this finite forward operator. Individual edge adjoints do **not** certify the whole inverse-transpose program with COPY/discard. Physical scalar/address lowering, prefix precision, global owners/idle/residual billing, the remaining 102 target corrections and all-size admission remain open. No new kappa or selected-record change. README/REVIEW/TASK give the next concrete obligations.

Canonical main refreshed unchanged at 11:11:42 UTC, priority revision 4. Submission overlap:653 open PRs including drafts at 11:11:51 UTC and1,185 Discussion records at 11:14:47 UTC, fully paginated/no warnings, plus 1,536 local README/TASK/ledger records. No arbitrary-diff/literature coverage is claimed. Earlier terminal-promotion/target-descent correction work in Discussion 2080 changes different paths; this is PR2445's fixed-source-path monotone-helper word. Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18947354.

Credit Ross Richardson/PR2445, commdata2338/PR2393, Hiroki Kumazaki/PR2353, Philippe Van Velzen, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991, Rohan Arun/PR1972, Adam Gall/PR1940, Josie Elliston/PR1071, Ali Romman/PR1125/1862 and icekylinx/PR531 with retained ancestry. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate mathematical checker author; no independent human or proof-kernel review. Apache-2.0; original sources, notices and licenses retained.
